# CMake integration

Rhodium generates CMake files for dependencies after restore.

## Generate integration files

```bash
rhodium generate --config debug --toolchain windows-msvc-x64
```

Default output:

```text
.rhodium/generated/cmake/
```

## Include generated files

Use a guarded include so a missing restore step produces a clear error.

```cmake
set(RHODIUM_DEPS_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.rhodium/generated/cmake/rhodiumConfig.cmake")
if(NOT EXISTS "${RHODIUM_DEPS_FILE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Rhodium dependencies were not generated. Run: rhodium restore && rhodium generate")
endif()
include("${RHODIUM_DEPS_FILE}")
```

## Link dependencies

The generated integration exposes dependency artifacts based on the manifest. Link using the names generated by Rhodium for your project.

```cmake
add_executable(app src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE rhodium::fmt)
```

## Regeneration rule

Run `rhodium generate` after:

- Adding or removing dependencies.
- Changing artifact declarations.
- Changing configuration or toolchain.
- Running `rhodium restore` after an update.
